description:
The Gomant Vibhushan Award is a prestigious honor conferred by the Government of Goa. 

It was established in the year 1989. 

The award aims to recognize and honor individuals for their exceptional contributions to the field of art, literature, education, and social service. 

The award is named after the historical name of Goa, which is Gomantak. 

It serves to promote and encourage the rich cultural heritage of Goa. 

The award is presented annually on Goa Liberation Day, which is celebrated on December 19. 

The first award was given in 1989, coinciding with the 28th anniversary of Goa's liberation from Portuguese rule. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award is one of the highest civilian honors in the state of Goa. 

The objective of the award is to acknowledge the significant contributions of Goans in various fields. 

It aims to inspire future generations to engage in cultural and social activities. 

The award not only honors individuals but also aims to promote the values of creativity and excellence. 

The recipients of the award are selected based on their outstanding achievements and contributions. 

The selection process is carried out by a committee formed by the Government of Goa. 

This committee consists of distinguished personalities from various fields. 

The committee evaluates nominations based on specific criteria such as originality, impact, and contribution to society. 

The award consists of a citation and a cash prize. 

As of the latest information, the cash prize is set at INR 1 lakh. 

The citation includes a detailed description of the recipient's contributions. 

The award is open to individuals from all walks of life. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility. 

However, candidates must have made significant contributions to Goa or its culture. 

Individuals who have received national or international recognition may be given preference. 

The application process for the Gomant Vibhushan Award involves submission of a nomination form. 

Nominations can be made by individuals or organizations. 

The nomination form requires detailed information about the nominee's contributions. 

Supporting documents such as certificates or letters of recommendation may also be required. 

Nominations must be submitted to the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. 

The deadline for submission is typically set a few months before the award ceremony. 

The exact date for the nomination deadline may vary each year. 

Once the nominations are received, the selection committee reviews them. 

The committee may conduct interviews or seek additional information if necessary. 

The final decision is made based on the committee's assessment of the nominees. 

The award ceremony is held on December 19 each year. 

During the ceremony, the Chief Minister of Goa typically presents the award. 

The event is attended by various dignitaries, including government officials and cultural figures. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award has been awarded to numerous distinguished individuals over the years. 

Notable recipients include artists, writers, and social activists. 

The award has helped to elevate the profile of Goan culture on a national level. 

It has also encouraged more individuals to contribute to the state's cultural landscape. 

The award is widely publicized in local media. 

This helps to raise awareness about the contributions of Goans to society. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Goa. 

This initiative aims to promote arts and culture in the state. 

The government also supports various cultural events and festivals throughout the year. 

These events provide platforms for local artists and performers. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award serves as a reminder of the importance of cultural heritage. 

It emphasizes the need for community engagement and social responsibility. 

The award has also inspired similar honors in other states of India. 

It reflects the commitment of the Government of Goa to recognize and celebrate talent. 

The award has become a symbol of pride for the people of Goa. 

It encourages individuals to strive for excellence in their respective fields. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award continues to play a vital role in the cultural landscape of Goa. 

It recognizes the diverse contributions of Goans to society. 

The award fosters a sense of community and belonging among the people. 

It highlights the importance of preserving and promoting Goan culture. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award is a testament to the rich history and heritage of Goa. 

It serves as an inspiration for future generations to engage in creative pursuits. 

The award not only honors individuals but also enriches the cultural fabric of the state. 

It is a significant recognition that encourages ongoing contributions to society. 

The Government of Goa remains committed to honoring those who make a difference. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award is an essential part of this commitment. 

It reflects the values of creativity, excellence, and social responsibility. 

The award continues to evolve and adapt to the changing cultural landscape. 

It remains a prestigious honor that is highly sought after by Goans. 

The legacy of the Gomant Vibhushan Award will continue to inspire future generations. 

It is a celebration of the spirit of Goa and its people. 

The award symbolizes the collective aspirations of the Goan community. 

It is a recognition of the power of art and culture in shaping society. 

The Gomant Vibhushan Award is more than just an honor; it is a celebration of life and creativity.
